14	// and returns the signed difference, or ErrDrift when it exceeds driftLimit in either direction.
15	func ReconcileBalances(booked, settled int64) (int64, error) {
16		diff := settled - booked

18			return diff, ErrDrift
19		}
20		return diff, nil
21	}
